dedupe_keys.name: usgs public supply water use reanalysis 2000 2020 by huc12 and water service area

description: This USGS reanalysis estimates monthly water withdrawn by public and private water suppliers across the conterminous United States from 2000 to 2020, covering water delivered for domestic, commercial, industrial, thermoelectric and public uses and water lost within supply systems, together with consumptive use. A machine-learning model trained on reported data produces estimates for each public-supply water service area and each 12-digit hydrologic unit, split into groundwater and surface water, and the release includes the model, its input features and the scripts that build them. It is part of the USGS national water-use modelling effort, was first published in November 2023 and revised as version 2.0 in August 2024, and is a free CSV download from ScienceBase. Caveats: values are modelled, not metered, and service-area boundaries follow the underlying service area dataset. Simulation uses: historical demand on public water systems for capacity planning and drought adaptation. Related records: EPA public water system service areas (data-epa-public-water-system-service-areas) and the USGS irrigation water use estimates (data-usgs-monthly-irrigation-water-use-huc12-2015).
